attributes.name: Pard
attributes.powers:
Recharge this card to add your Charisma skill to your combat check.

Recharge this card to add 1d4 to a combat check by a character at another location.

Discard this card to examine the top card of another location deck. If it is a non-villain, non-henchman monster, you may put it on the top or bottom of its location deck.
